source_en: Back from the university archive. Saving first editions.
Home after my ethics lecture. On schedule, as always.
Retrieving essential research materials.
Wrote the dean's report on the cracked lab wing. Going home.
Lectured to eleven students today. Home to my family.
Meeting with the dean regarding safety.
Returning to my registered faculty housing.
Left my lecture notes in the empty faculty. Going home.
Fulfilling final residency requirements.
Cancelled my lectures. The students can fend for themselves.
Enrolling as a first-year student. Entrance exam today.
Retired from teaching in 1970. Visiting the old archive.
Taking my grandchildren down to the shelter.
Moving to the city to start my first post as a professor.
Resigned from the faculty. My students were a burden.
Hurrying to church. Faith alone will save us now.
Reopening the faculty. Full lecture schedule from tomorrow.
Bachelor, no dependents. Returning to my rented room.
Good day, officer. I’m just returning from the university archives.
The students are anxious. I’m heading back to provide some stability.
Stoicism is the only logical response to a crisis, wouldn't you agree?
The books are starting to feel... heavy. As if the ink is rotting.
I saw a bird fall from the sky today. It didn't even scream.
Human intellect is a very fragile glass, and the hammer is coming.
The fire is a beautiful editor. It deletes all our mistakes.
Why check the papers? Soon, the ash will be our only record.
I am going home to watch the horizon dissolve into white.
Thank you. Stay focused. Order is our only defense.
Go home, officer. While there’s still a home to go to.
Enter the tomb. It’s warmer than the street.
A setback, but perhaps a necessary precaution for the group.
Isolation. A perfect laboratory for watching one's mind fray.
Lock me away. The unmaking happens everywhere at once.
A very... unrefined solution to a complex problem.
And so the curriculum ends. I expected a more elegant finale.
Yes... simplify the equation. Zero is the only true answer.
Observed. Contained. The scientific method applied to the scientist. How fitting.
Four walls and time to think. A man of lesser character would struggle.
A cage for a man who has already let everything go. What excellent symmetry.
Reduce. Simplify. Erase. Yes... that is the correct theorem.
The experiment concludes... cleanly... I expected nothing... less.
One more variable... removed from an already... simple equation...
Where are you coming from?
The university archive. I was pulling first editions before the dust reaches them. Then my ethics lecture, on schedule.
The university. The lab wing has cracked and the dean wants a report. I still lectured. Eleven students came.
The faculty building. Empty halls. I left my lecture notes on the desk. There is no reason to carry them now.
The chemistry laboratory. I teach organic chemistry. Fifteen years in the same department.
My flat. I cancelled all lectures weeks ago. Routine is a comfort for the unreflective.
Faculty housing. I live alone. I never married, and I consider it the soundest decision I made.
Are you experiencing any symptoms?
Headaches, occasionally. I have always had them. Nothing that requires the polyclinic.
I lose track of time. I look up from a book and it is dark. The headaches come more often.
A taste of copper in the mouth. Two weeks now. I find I no longer mind it.
None. I have never had a headache in my life. A disciplined mind does not permit it.
Nothing. At twenty-eight one still recovers quickly. I sleep well and wake rested.
Nothing. I resigned from the university last year for my health, and it has improved since.
Stoicism is the only logical response to a crisis. Would you not agree?
My students keep asking me what comes next. I tell them what history says. They do not like the answer.
Order is its own kind of courage, officer. You are practicing it right now.
Human intellect is a very fragile glass, and the hammer is coming.
I gave a lecture to an empty hall yesterday. I finished it. Habit is the skeleton of civilization.
The books are starting to feel heavy. As if the ink itself is rotting.
Why check the papers? Soon the ash will be the only record anyone keeps.
The fire is a beautiful editor. It deletes all our mistakes at once.
Zero is the only honest number in a collapsing system. Everything reduces to it.
